SKLabelNode\n        if let label = self.label {\n            label.alpha = 0.0\n            label.run(SKAction.fadeIn(withDuration: 2.0))\n        }\n        \n        // Create shape node to use during mouse interaction\n        let w = (self.size.width + self.size.height) * 0.05\n        self.spinnyNode = SKShapeNode.init(rectOf: CGSize.init(width: w, height: w), cornerRadius: w * 0.3)\n        \n        if let spinnyNode = self.spinnyNode {\n            spinnyNode.lineWidth = 2.5\n            \n            spinnyNode.run(SKAction.repeatForever(SKAction.rotate(byAngle: CGFloat(Double.pi), duration: 1)))\n            spinnyNode.run(SKAction.sequence([SKAction.wait(forDuration: 0.5),\n                                              SKAction.fadeOut(withDuration: 0.5),\n                                              SKAction.removeFromParent()]))\n        }\n    }\n    \n    \n    func touchDown(atPoint pos : CGPoint) {\n        if let n = self.spinnyNode?.copy() as!         "contents": "        for waypoint in viewModel.gameState.waypoints {\n            let node = SKShapeNode(circleOfRadius: waypoint.size)\n            \n            // Set color based on state\n            switch waypoint.state {\n            case .unknown:\n                node.fillColor = UIColor(red: 0, green: 200/255, blue: 1, alpha: 0.5)\n                node.strokeColor = UIColor(red: 0, green: 1, blue: 1, alpha: 1)\n            case .good:\n                node.fillColor = .green\n                node.strokeColor = .green\n            case .bad:\n                node.fillColor = .red\n                node.strokeColor = .red\n            }\n            \n            node.lineWidth = 2\n            node.position = waypoint.position\n            node.zPosition = 2\n            node.name = \"waypoint_\\(waypoint.id)\"\n            \n            // Add label if present\n            if let label = waypoint.label {\n                let labelNode = SKLabelNode(text: label)\n                labelNode.fontName = \"Arial-BoldMT\"\n                labelNode.fontSize = 12\n                labelNode.fontColor = waypoint.state == .unknown ? .black : .white\n                labelNode.verticalAlignmentMode = .center\n                labelNode.zPosition = 3\n                node.addChild(labelNode)\n            }\n            \n            addChild(node)\n            waypointNodes.append(node)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func updateBuggy() {\n        guard let viewModel = gameViewModel else { return }\n        ",

        "contents": "//\n//  GoonPopperViewModel.swift\n//  abbies.world.ios\n//\n//  Created for Goon Popper Minigame\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftUI\nimport Combine\nimport SpriteKit\n\nclass GoonPopperViewModel: ObservableObject {\n    @Published var gameState = GoonPopperGameState()\n    \n    private var cancellables = Set&lt;AnyCancellable&gt;()\n    private var timer: Timer?\n    \n    // Asset base URL\n    private var assetBaseURL: String {\n        let base = ServerConfig.shared.baseURL\n        return \"\\(base)/static/minigames/goonpopper\"\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Initialization\n    \n    init() {\n        // Default state\n    }\n    \n    deinit {\n        timer?.invalidate()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Asset Loading\n    \n    func loadAssets() async {\n        print(\"🎮 GoonPopper: Starting asset loading...\")\n        print(\"📍 Asset base URL: \\(assetBaseURL)\")\n        \n        await loadBackground()\n        await loadGoons()\n        await loadPlayButton()\n    }\n    \n    private func loadBackground() async {\n        // Randomly select background (1-3)\n        let backgroundIndex = Int.random(in: 1...3)\n        gameState.selectedBackgroundIndex = backgroundIndex\n        \n        let backgroundURLString = \"\\(assetBaseURL)/images/b\\(backgroundIndex).png\"\n        print(\"🖼️ Loading background \\(backgroundIndex) from: \\(backgroundURLString)\")\n        \n        if let url = URL(string: backgroundURLString) {\n            do {\n                if let image = try await ImageCache.shared.loadImage(from: url) {\n                    await MainActor.run {\n                        gameState.backgroundImage = image\n                        print(\"✅ Background loaded successfully\")\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    print(\"⚠️ Failed to load background: ImageCache returned nil\")\n                }\n            } catch {\n                print(\"❌ Error loading background: \\(error)\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func loadGoons() async {\n        print(\"🖼️ Loading \\(gameState.totalGoons) goon images...\")",

        "contents": "//\n//  FloatingGenerationButton.swift\n//  abbies.world.ios\n//\n//  Floating action button for generation when drawer is closed\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct FloatingGenerationButton: View {\n    let state: GenerationButtonState\n    let action: () -&gt; Void\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        VStack {\n            Spacer()\n            HStack {\n                Spacer()\n                Button(action: action) {\n                    ZStack {\n                        // White circle background\n                        Circle()\n                            .fill(Color.white)\n                            .frame(width: 128, height: 128)\n                        \n                        // Video player\n                        VideoPlayerView(videoName: videoName, isLooping: true)\n                            .frame(width: 128, height: 128)\n                            .clipShape(Circle())\n                        \n                        // Thick black outline\n                        Circle()\n                            .stroke(Color.black, lineWidth: 4)\n                            .frame(width: 128, height: 128)\n                    }\n                    .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.3), radius: 8, x: 0, y: 4)\n                }\n                .disabled(!isReady)\n                .opacity(isReady ? 1.0 : 0.6)\n                .frame(width: 128, height: 128, alignment: .bottomTrailing)\n                .padding(.trailing, 24)\n                .padding(.bottom, 24)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private var videoName: String {\n        switch state {\n        case .notReady:\n            return \"robot_waving_white_background\"\n        case .ready:\n            return \"robot_paint_brush_waving\"\n        case .generating:\n            return \"robot_running_treadmill\"\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private var isReady: Bool {\n        switch state {\n        case .ready, .generating:\n            return true\n        default:\n            return false\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    ZStack {\n        Color.gray.opacity(0.2)",

        "contents": "    private func updateBuggy() {\n        guard let viewModel = gameViewModel else { return }\n        \n        // Remove old buggy node\n        buggyNode?.removeFromParent()\n        \n        guard let buggyImage = viewModel.gameState.buggyImage else { return }\n        \n        let texture = SKTexture(image: buggyImage)\n        buggyNode = SKSpriteNode(texture: texture)\n        \n        // Apply pulse animation\n        let baseScale: CGFloat = 0.08\n        let pulseScale = baseScale * (1 + viewModel.gameState.buggyPulse)\n        buggyNode?.setScale(pulseScale)\n        \n        buggyNode?.position = viewModel.gameState.buggyPosition\n        buggyNode?.zPosition = 4\n        \n        // Add glow effect\n        let glowSize = CGSize(width: 20 * (1 + viewModel.gameState.buggyPulse * 0.5),\n                             height: 12 * (1 + viewModel.gameState.buggyPulse * 0.5))\n        let glow = SKShapeNode(ellipseOf: glowSize)\n        glow.fillColor = .green\n        glow.alpha = 0.3\n        glow.position = CGPoint(x: 0, y: 5)\n        glow.zPosition = -1\n        buggyNode?.addChild(glow)\n        \n        // Inner glow\n        let innerGlow = SKShapeNode(ellipseOf: CGSize(width: 15 * (1 + viewModel.gameState.buggyPulse * 0.5),\n                                                      height: 8 * (1 + viewModel.gameState.buggyPulse * 0.5)))\n        innerGlow.fillColor = .green\n        innerGlow.alpha = 0.6\n        innerGlow.position = CGPoint(x: 0, y: 5)\n        innerGlow.zPosition = -1\n        buggyNode?.addChild(innerGlow)\n        \n        addChild(buggyNode!)\n    }\n    \n    private func updateMoonbase() {\n        guard let viewModel = gameViewModel else { return }\n        ",

        "contents": "//\n//  WaypointGameCanvas.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created for Waypoint Navigation Minigame\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\nimport SpriteKit\nimport UIKit\n\nstruct WaypointGameCanvas: UIViewRepresentable {\n    @ObservedObject var viewModel: WaypointGameViewModel\n    \n    func makeUIView(context: Context) -&gt; SKView {\n        let view = SKView()\n        view.preferredFramesPerSecond = 60\n        view.ignoresSiblingOrder = true\n        \n        let scene = WaypointGameScene(viewModel: viewModel)\n        scene.scaleMode = .aspectFit\n        scene.backgroundColor = .clear\n        \n        view.presentScene(scene)\n        \n        return view\n    }\n    \n    func updateUIView(_ uiView: SKView, context: Context) {\n        // Update scene if needed\n    }\n}\n\nclass WaypointGameScene: SKScene {\n    weak var gameViewModel: WaypointGameViewModel?\n    \n    private var buggyNode: SKSpriteNode?\n    private var moonbaseNode: SKSpriteNode?\n    private var waypointNodes: [SKShapeNode] = []\n    private var pathNode: SKShapeNode?\n    \n    init(viewModel: WaypointGameViewModel) {\n        self.gameViewModel = viewModel\n        super.init(size: CGSize(width: 860, height: 500))\n    }\n    \n    required init?(coder aDecoder: NSCoder) {\n        fatalError(\"init(coder:) has not been implemented\")\n    }\n    \n    override func didMove(to view: SKView) {\n        setupScene()\n    }\n    \n    private func setupScene() {\n        // Draw stars background\n        drawStars()\n        \n        // Setup path node\n        pathNode = SKShapeNode()\n        pathNode?.strokeColor = .green\n        pathNode?.lineWidth = 3\n        pathNode?.lineCap = .round\n        pathNode?.lineJoin = .round\n        pathNode?.zPosition = 1\n        addChild(pathNode!)\n        \n        // Setup waypoint nodes\n        updateWaypoints()\n        \n        // Setup buggy\n        updateBuggy()\n        \n        // Setup moonbase\n        updateMoonbase()\n    }\n    \n    private func drawStars() {\n        for i in 0..&lt;50 {\n            let x = CGFloat((i * 137) % Int(size.width))",

        "contents": "struct PolaroidView: View {\n    let image: UIImage\n    let index: Int\n    let isVisible: Bool\n    let currentIndex: Int\n    let totalCount: Int\n    \n    private var offset: PolaroidOffset {\n        let polaroidOffset = (index - currentIndex + totalCount) % totalCount\n        let stackOffset = min(polaroidOffset, 5)\n        \n        return PolaroidOffset(\n            x: Double(stackOffset * 5),\n            y: Double(stackOffset * 3),\n            scale: 1.0 - Double(stackOffset) * 0.05,\n            rotation: Double(stackOffset * 2),\n            opacity: max(0.3, 1.0 - Double(stackOffset) * 0.15),\n            zIndex: 100 - Double(polaroidOffset)\n        )\n    }\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        Image(uiImage: image)\n            .resizable()\n            .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)\n            .frame(width: 600, height: 600)\n            .border(Color.white, width: 8)\n            .background(Color.white)\n            .padding(.bottom, 40) // Polaroid frame effect\n            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.8), radius: 16)\n            .offset(x: isVisible ? offset.x : 0, y: isVisible ? offset.y : -100)\n            .scaleEffect(isVisible ? offset.scale : 0.3)\n            .rotationEffect(.degrees(isVisible ? offset.rotation : 180))\n            .opacity(isVisible ? offset.opacity : 0)\n            .zIndex(offset.zIndex)\n            .animation(isVisible ? .spring(response: 1.2, dampingFraction: 0.4) : nil, value: isVisible)\n            .animation(.spring(response: 0.5, dampingFraction: 0.8), value: currentIndex)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct PolaroidOffset: Equatable {\n    let x: Double\n    let y: Double\n    let scale: Double\n    let rotation: Double\n    let opacity: Double\n    let zIndex: Double\n    \n    static func == (lhs: PolaroidOffset, rhs: PolaroidOffset) -&gt; Bool {\n        lhs.x == rhs.x &amp;&amp; lhs.y == rhs.y &amp;&amp; lhs.scale == rhs.scale &amp;&amp;\n        lhs.rotation == rhs.rotation &amp;&amp; lhs.opacity == rhs.opacity &amp;&amp; lhs.zIndex == rhs.zIndex\n    }\n}",

Added music playback to GoonPopper.

## Changes Made:

1. **Created `GoonPopperAudioService.swift`** — Audio service following the WaypointGameAudioService pattern:
   - Loads background music from `/static/assets/music/goonpopper/background.mp3`
   - Loops infinitely
   - Handles errors
   - Stops on cleanup

2. **Updated `GoonPopperViewModel.swift`**:
   - Added `audioService` property
   - Starts music in `loadAssets()`
   - Stops music in `cleanup()`

## Note:

The service looks for `background.mp3` in the `music/goonpopper` folder. If your file has a different name, update line 30 in `GoonPopperAudioService.swift`:

```swift
let musicFilename = "background.mp3" // Change this to your actual filename
```

The music will:
- Start automatically when the game loads assets
- Loop continuously during gameplay
- Stop when the game is dismissed or cleaned up

The service coordinates with the main MusicService (if active) since each service manages its own audio session.

        "contents": "# Music Playback Implementation - Risk Analysis\n\n## 🔴 Critical Risks (High Impact, High Probability)\n\n### 1. **Audio Session Conflicts**\n**Risk:** &#96;WaypointGameAudioService&#96; and &#96;MusicService&#96; both call &#96;setActive(true)&#96; on the shared &#96;AVAudioSession&#96;, which can cause conflicts.\n\n**Impact:** \n- Music stops when minigame starts\n- Minigame audio doesn't play if music is active\n- Audio session errors/crashes\n\n**Mitigation:**\n- **Centralized Audio Session Manager:** Create &#96;AudioSessionManager&#96; singleton that coordinates all audio services\n- **Priority System:** Minigame audio takes priority, pauses background music\n- **Shared Session Management:** Only one service manages &#96;setActive()&#96;, others request activation\n\n**Probability:** High (both services will be active simultaneously)\n\n---\n\n### 2. **Memory Leaks from AVAudioPlayer**\n**Risk:** &#96;AVAudioPlayer&#96; instances not properly released, causing memory accumulation over time.\n\n**Impact:**\n- App crashes after extended use\n- Performance degradation\n- Battery drain\n\n**Mitigation:**\n- **Strict Cleanup:** Always call &#96;stop()&#96; and set to &#96;nil&#96; in &#96;deinit&#96;\n- **Weak References:** Use &#96;[weak self]&#96; in all closures\n- **Single Player Instance:** Only keep one &#96;AVAudioPlayer&#96; active at a time\n- **Memory Monitoring:** Add logging to track player lifecycle\n\n**Probability:** Medium-High (common AVAudioPlayer pitfall)\n\n---\n\n### 3. **Background Playback Interruptions**\n**Risk:** iOS system interruptions (phone calls, other apps, silent switch) stop music unexpectedly.\n\n**Impact:**\n- Poor user experience (music stops randomly)\n- State desync (app thinks music is playing but it's not)\n- Settings toggle doesn't match actual state\n\n**Mitigation:**\n- **Audio Session Interruption Handlers:** Implement &#96;AVAudioSessionInterruptionNotification&#96; observers\n- **State Reconciliation:** Check actual playback state on app foreground\n- **Graceful Recovery:** Auto-resume if music was enabled when interrupted\n\n**Probability:** Medium (iOS system behavior)\n\n---",

        "contents": "# Victory Sequence &amp; Music Coordination Investigation Report\n\n## Issue 1: Music Conflict - MainView Music vs Game Music\n\n### Problem\nMainView music doesn't reliably stop before game music starts, causing audio conflict.\n\n### Root Cause Analysis\n\n**Timing Issue:**\n1. &#96;WaypointNavigationView&#96; appears → &#96;onAppear&#96; fires\n2. &#96;onAppear&#96; calls &#96;viewModel.loadAssets()&#96; (line 136)\n3. &#96;loadAssets()&#96; immediately calls &#96;audioService.playBackgroundMusic()&#96; (line 68)\n4. &#96;MainView.onChange(of: showWaypointGame)&#96; fires when &#96;showWaypointGame = true&#96; (line 202)\n5. This calls &#96;MusicService.shared.setGameActive(true)&#96; which pauses MainView music (line 114-120)\n\n**Race Condition:**\n- The game music starts in &#96;onAppear&#96; (immediate)\n- MainView music pause happens in &#96;onChange&#96; (may be slightly delayed)\n- Result: Both play simultaneously for a brief moment\n\n### Current Code Flow:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nWaypointNavigationView.onAppear\n  → viewModel.loadAssets()\n    → audioService.playBackgroundMusic()  // STARTS IMMEDIATELY\n  \nMainView.onChange(of: showWaypointGame)\n  → MusicService.setGameActive(true)      // PAUSES (may be delayed)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Fix Needed:\nDelay game music start until after MainView music is confirmed paused, OR ensure &#96;setGameActive&#96; is called synchronously before the view appears.\n\n---\n\n## Issue 2: Victory Sequence Not Starting/Finishing\n\n### Problem\nVictory sequence doesn't reliably start, and never finishes completely.\n\n### Root Cause Analysis\n\n#### 2a. Sequence Not Starting\n\n**Potential Issues:**\n\n1. **&#96;gameComplete&#96; may not trigger &#96;onChange&#96;:**\n   - &#96;gameComplete&#96; is set in &#96;completeGame()&#96; (line 465)\n   - &#96;completeGame()&#96; is called after 0.8s delay (line 378-379)\n   - &#96;onChange(of: gameComplete)&#96; should fire (line 142-148)\n   - **BUT**: If the view is dismissed or deallocated before the delay completes, &#96;gameComplete&#96; is set but &#96;onChange&#96; never fires\n\n2. **View lifecycle issue:**\n   - &#96;showVictory&#96; is set to &#96;true&#96; in &#96;onChange&#96; (line 146)",

        "contents": "@objc private func handleAudioInterruption(_ notification: Notification) {\n    guard let userInfo = notification.userInfo,\n          let typeValue = userInfo[AVAudioSessionInterruptionTypeKey] as? UInt,\n          let type = AVAudioSession.InterruptionType(rawValue: typeValue) else {\n        return\n    }\n    \n    switch type {\n    case .began:\n        // Interruption started (phone call, etc.)\n        print(\"🔇 MusicService: Audio interruption began\")\n        wasPlayingBeforeInterruption = isPlaying\n        if isPlaying {\n            pause()\n        }\n        \n    case .ended:\n        // Interruption ended\n        print(\"🔊 MusicService: Audio interruption ended\")\n        if let optionsValue = userInfo[AVAudioSessionInterruptionOptionKey] as?         "contents": "init() {\n    // Listen for game lifecycle\n    NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(\n        self,\n        selector: #selector(gameDidStart),\n        name: .gameDidStart,\n        object: nil\n    )\n    NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(\n        self,\n        selector: #selector(gameDidEnd),\n        name: .gameDidEnd,\n        object: nil\n    )\n}\n\n@objc private func gameDidStart() {\n    pauseForGame()\n}\n\n@objc private func gameDidEnd() {\n    resumeAfterGame()\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**MainView:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n.fullScreenCover(isPresented: $showWaypointGame) {\n    WaypointNavigationView(...)\n}\n.onChange(of: showWaypointGame) { oldValue, newValue in\n    if newValue {\n        NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .gameDidStart, object: nil)\n    } else {\n        NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .gameDidEnd, object: nil)\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Extension:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nextension Notification.Name {\n    static let gameDidStart = Notification.Name(\"gameDidStart\")\n    static let gameDidEnd =         "contents": "# Music Playback Implementation - Complete\n\n## ✅ What Was Built\n\n### 1. **MusicTrack Model** (&#96;Models/MusicTrack.swift&#96;)\n- Represents a single music track with metadata\n- Converts from &#96;Asset&#96; model\n- Provides cleaned display names (removes .mp3, replaces underscores)\n- Includes &#96;RepeatMode&#96; enum (all, one, none)\n\n### 2. **MusicService** (&#96;Services/MusicService.swift&#96;)\n**Core Features:**\n- ✅ Fetches music playlist from server via AssetsService\n- ✅ Caches playlist to UserDefaults (24-hour validity)\n- ✅ Caches audio files to disk (&#96;Documents/MusicCache/&#96;)\n- ✅ Playback management with AVAudioPlayer\n- ✅ Shuffle mode (generates random queue)\n- ✅ Repeat mode (all, one, none)\n- ✅ Song selection (play specific song, then continue queue)\n- ✅ Game coordination (pauses when game starts, resumes when game ends)\n- ✅ Audio interruption handling (phone calls, etc.)\n- ✅ Settings persistence (shuffle, music on/off, current song)\n- ✅ Auto-play on startup if music enabled\n\n**Key Methods:**\n- &#96;loadPlaylist()&#96; - Fetch from server, cache locally\n- &#96;play()&#96; / &#96;pause()&#96; / &#96;stop()&#96; - Playback control\n- &#96;toggleMusic()&#96; - Enable/disable music\n- &#96;toggleShuffle()&#96; - Enable/disable shuffle\n- &#96;playSong(_:)&#96; - Play specific song\n- &#96;setGameActive(_:)&#96; - Coordinate with game lifecycle\n\n### 3. **SettingsView Updates** (&#96;Views/Components/SettingsView.swift&#96;)\n**New Music Controls Section:**\n- ✅ Music On/Off toggle\n- ✅ Shuffle On/Off toggle\n- ✅ Song selector list with:\n  - Currently playing indicator (▶️ icon)\n  - Play/pause state display\n  - Tap to select and play song\n  - Highlighted current song\n\n### 4. **MainView Integration**\n- ✅ Game lifecycle coordination via &#96;.onChange(of: showWaypointGame)&#96;\n- ✅ Calls &#96;MusicService.shared.setGameActive()&#96; when game starts/ends\n\n### 5. **MainViewModel Integration**\n- ✅ Initializes &#96;MusicService.shared&#96; on app startup\n- ✅ Music service loads playlist automatically\n\n## 🎯 How It Works\n\n### Startup Flow:\n1. App launches → &#96;MainViewModel.init()&#96; → &#96;MusicService.shared&#96; created\n2. &#96;MusicService.init()&#96; → Checks cache → Loads playlist (cache or server)",

        "contents": "### Startup Flow:\n1. App launches → &#96;MainViewModel.init()&#96; → &#96;MusicService.shared&#96; created\n2. &#96;MusicService.init()&#96; → Checks cache → Loads playlist (cache or server)\n3. If music enabled → Auto-plays first song\n\n### Playback Flow:\n1. Song ends → &#96;audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying&#96; delegate called\n2. Check repeat mode:\n   - &#96;.one&#96; → Already looping, continue\n   - &#96;.all&#96; → Move to next song (respects shuffle)\n   - &#96;.none&#96; → Stop playback\n3. Load next song → Cache check → Play\n\n### Game Coordination:\n1. User opens game → &#96;showWaypointGame = true&#96;\n2. &#96;MainView.onChange&#96; → &#96;MusicService.setGameActive(true)&#96;\n3. Music pauses, remembers state\n4. Game ends → &#96;showWaypointGame = false&#96;\n5. &#96;MusicService.setGameActive(false)&#96; → Resumes if was playing\n\n### Interruption Handling:\n1. Phone call / other app → &#96;AVAudioSession.interruptionNotification&#96;\n2. Music pauses, remembers state\n3. Interruption ends → Resumes if appropriate\n\n## 📁 Files Created/Modified\n\n**New Files:**\n- &#96;Models/MusicTrack.swift&#96;\n- &#96;Services/MusicService.swift&#96;\n\n**Modified Files:**\n- &#96;Views/Components/SettingsView.swift&#96; - Added music controls\n- &#96;Views/MainView.swift&#96; - Added game coordination\n- &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96; - Initialize music service\n\n## 🧪 Testing Checklist\n\n- [ ] Music loads on app startup\n- [ ] Playlist appears in Settings\n- [ ] Music toggle works\n- [ ] Shuffle toggle works\n- [ ] Song selection works\n- [ ] Music pauses when game starts\n- [ ] Music resumes when game ends\n- [ ] Music handles phone calls (interruptions)\n- [ ] Settings persist across app restarts\n- [ ] Cache works offline\n- [ ] Playback continues through playlist\n- [ ] Repeat mode works\n\n## 🐛 Known Issues / Future Improvements\n\n- Repeat mode selector UI (currently defaults to &#96;.all&#96;)\n- Volume control slider\n- Now playing info in drawer\n- Fade in/out between songs\n- Playback progress indicator\n\n## 🎉 Ready to Test!\n\nThe music system is fully implemented and ready for testing. All core features are in place:\n- ✅ Playlist loading with caching\n- ✅ Playback with shuffle/repeat",

Data(contentsOf: path) else {\n            print(\"⚠️ MusicService: Failed to read cached file\")\n            playNext()\n            return\n        }\n        playAudioData(data)\n    }\n    \n    private func playAudioData(_ data: Data) {\n        // Ensure we're not creating multiple players\n        if audioPlayer != nil {\n            print(\"⚠️ MusicService: Audio player already exists, cleaning up first\")\n            audioPlayer?.stop()\n            audioPlayer?.delegate = nil\n            audioPlayer = nil\n        }\n        \n        do {\n            let player = try AVAudioPlayer(data: data)\n            player.delegate = self\n            player.numberOfLoops = (repeatMode == .one) ? -1 : 0\n            player.volume = 0.5\n            \n            // Prepare before playing to reduce audio system load\n            guard player.prepareToPlay() else {\n                print(\"❌ MusicService: Failed to prepare audio player\")\n                playNext()\n                return\n            }\n            \n            guard player.play() else {\n                print(\"❌ MusicService: Failed to start audio playback\")\n                playNext()\n                return\n            }\n            \n            audioPlayer = player\n            isPlaying = true\n            saveSettings()\n            \n            print(\"✅ MusicService: Now playing: \\(currentSong?.displayName ?? \"Unknown\")\")\n        } catch {\n            print(\"❌ MusicService: Failed to create audio player: \\(error)\")\n            playNext() // Skip to next\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - AVAudioPlayerDelegate\n    \n    func audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_ player: AVAudioPlayer, successfully flag: Bool) {\n        guard player == audioPlayer else { return }\n        \n        if repeatMode == .one {\n            // Already looping, nothing to do\n            return\n        }\n        \n        // Move to next song\n        playNext()\n    }\n    \n    func audioPlayerDecodeErrorDidOccur(_ player: AVAudioPlayer, error: Error?) {\n        print(\"❌ MusicService: Audio decode error: \\(error?.localizedDescription ?? \"Unknown\")\")",

        "contents": "# Music Playback Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\nImplement background music playback system that cycles through music files from the server, with shuffle/repeat controls accessible via Settings.\n\n## Architecture\n\n### 1. **MusicService** (New Service)\n**Location:** &#96;Services/MusicService.swift&#96;\n\n**Responsibilities:**\n- Fetch music assets from server on startup (via AssetsService)\n- Cache playlist in memory and UserDefaults (for offline access)\n- Manage playback queue (shuffle/normal order)\n- Handle repeat mode (repeat all, repeat one, no repeat)\n- Play next/previous song automatically\n- Handle song selection (play specific song, then continue with queue)\n- Persist settings (music on/off, shuffle on/off, current song)\n\n**Key Features:**\n- Uses &#96;AVAudioPlayer&#96; (similar to WaypointGameAudioService pattern)\n- Implements &#96;AVAudioPlayerDelegate&#96; for track completion\n- Reactive with &#96;@Published&#96; properties for UI binding\n- Caches audio data to disk for offline playback\n- Handles audio session management\n\n**State Management:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n@Published var isPlaying: Bool = false\n@Published var currentSong: MusicTrack?\n@Published var playlist: [MusicTrack] = []\n@Published var isShuffleEnabled: Bool = false\n@Published var isMusicEnabled: Bool = true\n@Published var repeatMode: RepeatMode = .all // .all, .one, .none\n@Published var isLoading: Bool = false\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Methods:**\n- &#96;loadPlaylist()&#96; - Fetch from AssetsService, cache to UserDefaults\n- &#96;play()&#96; - Start/resume playback\n- &#96;pause()&#96; - Pause playback\n- &#96;playNext()&#96; - Advance to next song (respects shuffle)\n- &#96;playPrevious()&#96; - Go to previous song\n- &#96;playSong(_ track: MusicTrack)&#96; - Play specific song, then continue queue\n- &#96;toggleShuffle()&#96; - Enable/disable shuffle\n- &#96;setRepeatMode(_ mode: RepeatMode)&#96; - Change repeat mode\n- &#96;toggleMusic()&#96; - Enable/disable music (on/off)\n\n### 2. **MusicTrack Model** (New Model)\n**Location:** &#96;Models/MusicTrack.swift&#96;\n\n**Structure:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nstruct MusicTrack: Codable, Identifiable, Hashable {\n    let id: String\n    let name: String\n    let url: String // Server path like \"/static/assets/music/song.mp3\"",

        "contents": "    \n    func playSong(_ track: MusicTrack) {\n        guard let index = playlist.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == track.id }) else {\n            print(\"⚠️ MusicService: Track not found in playlist\")\n            return\n        }\n        \n        print(\"🎵 MusicService: Switching to song: \\(track.displayName)\")\n        \n        // Stop current playback and clean up properly\n        if let player = audioPlayer {\n            player.stop()\n            player.delegate = nil // Remove delegate to prevent callbacks during transition\n        }\n        audioPlayer = nil\n        isPlaying = false\n        \n        // Update to new song BEFORE loading (so loadAndPlayCurrentSong can find it)\n        currentIndex = index\n        currentSong = track\n        \n        // Small delay to ensure audio system is ready and old player is fully stopped\n        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.15) { [weak self] in\n            guard let self = self else { return }\n            // Double-check we still have a current song (shouldn't be nil at this point)\n            guard self.currentSong != nil else {\n                print(\"❌ MusicService: currentSong became nil before loading\")\n                return\n            }\n            self.loadAndPlayCurrentSong()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Queue Management\n    \n    private func generateShuffleQueue() {\n        var indices = Array(0..&lt;playlist.count)\n        indices.shuffle()\n        shuffledQueue = indices\n    }\n    \n    private func getNextIndex() -&gt; Int? {\n        guard !playlist.isEmpty else { return nil }\n        ",

        "contents": "//\n//  WaypointGameViewModel.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created for Waypoint Navigation Minigame\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftUI\nimport Combine\nimport UIKit\n\nclass WaypointGameViewModel: ObservableObject {\n    @Published var gameState = WaypointGameState()\n    \n    private var cancellables = Set&lt;AnyCancellable&gt;()\n    private var buggyAnimationTimer: Timer?\n    private var pulseTimer: Timer?\n    let audioService = WaypointGameAudioService()\n    \n    // Asset base URL - uses centralized ServerConfig\n    // Uses Assets API route for nested directory structure\n    private var assetBaseURL: String {\n        let base = ServerConfig.shared.baseURL\n        return \"\\(base)/static/assets/minigames/waypoint\"\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Initialization\n    \n    init() {\n        loadDefaultWaypoints()\n        setupPulseAnimation()\n    }\n    \n    deinit {\n        buggyAnimationTimer?.invalidate()\n        pulseTimer?.invalidate()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Game Setup\n    \n    func loadDefaultWaypoints() {\n        gameState.waypoints = WaypointGameState.defaultWaypoints()\n        \n        // Build good nodes order\n        let goodNodes = gameState.waypoints.filter { $0.isTraversable }\n        gameState.totalGoodNodes = goodNodes.count\n        gameState.goodNodesOrder = gameState.waypoints\n            .enumerated()\n            .filter { $0.element.isTraversable }\n            .map { $0.offset }\n        gameState.currentGoodNodeIndex = 0\n        \n        updateStatusMessage()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Includes implemented games and ideas for future games with complexity ratings and kid appeal scores.\n\n### &#96;MUSIC_COORDINATION_PLAN.md&#96;\nPlan for coordinating MusicService with WaypointGameAudioService to prevent audio session conflicts.         "contents": "import AVFoundation\n\nclass {GameName}AudioService: NSObject, ObservableObject, AVAudioPlayerDelegate {\n    private var backgroundMusicPlayer: AVAudioPlayer?\n    \n    // Asset base URL\n    private var assetBaseURL: String {\n        let base = ServerConfig.shared.baseURL\n        return \"\\(base)/static/assets/minigames/{game_name}\"\n    }\n    \n    override init() {\n        super.init()\n        setupAudioSession()\n    }\n    \n    deinit {\n        stopAllAudio()\n    }\n    \n    private func setupAudioSession() {\n        do {\n            try AVAudioSession.sharedInstance().setCategory(.playback, mode: .default)\n            try AVAudioSession.sharedInstance().setActive(true)\n        } catch {\n            print(\"⚠️ Failed to setup audio session: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n    \n    func playBackgroundMusic() {\n        // Load and play background music\n    }\n    \n    func stopAllAudio() {\n        backgroundMusicPlayer?.stop()\n        backgroundMusicPlayer = nil\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Key Points:**\n- Self-contained audio management\n- Uses &#96;ServerConfig.shared&#96; for URLs\n- Proper cleanup\n- Implements &#96;AVAudioPlayerDelegate&#96; if needed\n\n---\n\n## Integration Pattern\n\n### In Main App\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n// MainView.swift\nstruct MainView: View {\n    @State private var show{GameName} = false\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        // ... main app content\n        \n        .fullScreenCover(isPresented: $show{GameName}) {\n            {GameName}View(\n                onDismiss: {\n                    show{GameName} = false\n                },\n                onComplete: {\n                    show{GameName} = false\n                    // Handle completion (show celebration, etc.)\n                }\n            )\n        }\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Key Points:**\n- Use &#96;fullScreenCover&#96; for immersive games\n- Use &#96;sheet&#96; for simpler games\n- Pass optional callbacks for integration\n- Game works fine without callbacks\n\n---\n\n## Dependencies\n\n### Shared Services (OK to Use)\n\nThese are shared but don't create tight coupling:\n\n1. **ServerConfig.shared**\n   - Provides base URL",

## Solution: Independent services with lifecycle coordination

No centralized audio manager is needed. The current pattern works and is documented.

### What I've done

1. Created `BaseGameAudioService` — base class for all minigame audio services
   - Consistent audio session setup
   - Standard background music loading
   - Automatic cleanup
   - Uses `.mixWithOthers` to prevent conflicts

2. Updated `GoonPopperAudioService` — now inherits from `BaseGameAudioService`
   - Simpler code (just override `assetBaseURL` and `musicFilename`)
   - Follows the same pattern as other games

3. Created documentation — `docs/current-state/AUDIO_COORDINATION_PATTERN.md`
   - Explains the coordination pattern
   - Shows how to add new games
   - Troubleshooting guide

### How it works

**Current Pattern (No Central Manager Needed):**

```
Game Opens → MainView calls MusicService.setGameActive(true)
           → MusicService pauses (remembers state)
           → Game audio starts playing
           
Game Closes → Game audio stops (in deinit)
           → MainView calls MusicService.setGameActive(false)
           → MusicService resumes (if it was playing before)
```

**Key points:**
- Each service manages its own audio session
- `MusicService` pauses when games start
- Game audio stops automatically when views are dismissed
- Services coordinate via lifecycle callbacks, not a central manager

### Benefits

- Decoupled — services remain independent
- Simple — just pause/resume based on game state
- Consistent — all games follow the same pattern via `BaseGameAudioService`
- Automatic — game audio stops in `deinit` when views are dismissed

### For future minigames

1. Create audio service inheriting from `BaseGameAudioService`
2. Override `assetBaseURL` and `musicFilename`
3. Add to ViewModel: `let audioService = GameAudioService()`
4. Call `audioService.playBackgroundMusic()` in `loadAssets()`
5. Add `.onChange` in MainView to call `MusicService.shared.setGameActive()`

The pattern is documented and ready to use. No centralized manager is needed.

## Summary

**Answer: No centralized audio manager needed**

The current pattern works:
- Independent services with lifecycle coordination
- `MusicService` pauses when games start
- Game audio stops automatically when views are dismissed
- All games follow the same pattern via `BaseGameAudioService`

I've:
1. Created `BaseGameAudioService` for consistency
2. Updated `GoonPopperAudioService` to use it
3. Documented the pattern in `docs/current-state/AUDIO_COORDINATION_PATTERN.md`

The pattern is simple, decoupled, and scales to new minigames.

## GoonPopper integration complete

### Changes made

1. MainView.swift
   - Added `@State private var showGoonPopper = false`
   - Added `fullScreenCover` for GoonPopper with callbacks
   - Added `.onChange` handler to coordinate with `MusicService`
   - Updated `GamesDialogView` to include `showGoonPopper` binding

2. GamesDialogView.swift
   - Added `showGoonPopper` binding parameter
   - Added Goon Popper button to the games grid
   - Changed grid to 3 columns (was 2)
   - Updated preview

### Audio coordination

GoonPopper now follows the same pattern as WaypointGame:
- When GoonPopper opens → `MusicService` pauses background music
- When GoonPopper closes → `MusicService` resumes background music (if it was playing)
- GoonPopper audio plays during gameplay
- GoonPopper audio stops automatically when the view is dismissed

### Result

GoonPopper is:
- Accessible from the Games dialog
- Integrated with audio coordination
- Following the same pattern as other minigames
- Ready to play

The game will appear in the Games dialog with an orange "Goon Popper" button, and audio coordination is handled automatically.
